note: baseUrl is the live address of the site. It is used for canonical links, hreflang tags, the sitemap, the share cards and the QR code. After buying a domain, put it here (for example https://maxdarkosadze.ge) and run `python3 tools/brand.py && python3 build.py` — everything follows.
analyticsNote: Leave both empty for no analytics at all. For free, privacy-friendly counting: register a name at goatcounter.com and put it in "goatcounter" (just the name, not the URL). For Plausible, put the site domain in "plausible". Then run python3 build.py.
formNote: The contact form only appears once this is filled in. Create a free form at formspree.io (or basin.com / getform.io), copy the endpoint it gives you — it looks like https://formspree.io/f/abcdwxyz — paste it here and run python3 build.py. Leave it empty and the contact page simply shows the e-mail and Instagram links.
guestbookNote: Empty means the site is served as plain static files: the guest-book page shows the notes kept in the content files and quietly hides the form. To accept notes live, run server/guestbook.py as the web process (see the README — on Railway that is Settings -> Deploy -> Custom Start Command, NOT a Procfile) and set this to "/api/guestbook".
